base_sm_clock_mhz.provenance: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti published specification (Ampere GA102), base SM clock 1560 MHz.

boost_sm_clock_mhz.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti (driver 595.71.05, CUDA 13.2): cudaDeviceGetAttribute(cudaDevAttrClockRate) = 1890000 kHz = 1890 MHz.

dram_bytes_per_s.provenance: Derived from the 384-bit bus (cudaDeviceProp.memoryBusWidth = 384 from the live query) and the 21 Gbps GDDR6X effective data rate: 21.0e9 transfers/s * (384/8) bytes = 1.008e12 B/s; matches the RTX 3090 Ti vendor spec of 1008 GB/s.

fp16_tensor_dense_flops_per_s.provenance: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti published specification: 3rd-gen Tensor Cores, 160 TFLOPS FP16 dense (without sparsity).

fp32_flops_per_s.provenance: Derived: 2 FLOP/FFMA * (live multiProcessorCount 84 SM * 128 FP32 lanes/SM = 10752 CUDA cores) * 1.89e9 Hz boost = 4.064256e13 FLOP/s; matches the RTX 3090 Ti vendor spec of ~40 TFLOPS FP32.

memory_clock_mhz.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti: cudaDeviceGetAttribute(cudaDevAttrMemoryClockRate) = 10501000 kHz = 10501 MHz (GDDR6X; 21 Gbps effective data rate).

sm_count.provenance: Live device query on the local RTX 3090 Ti: cudaGetDeviceProperties(...).multiProcessorCount = 84 (GA102, sm_86).
